nodes.label: Toggle details no-op after section navigation (bug)
nodes.rationale: InteractiveState::element_states is keyed only by ElementId{block_idx, sub_idx}; a previous section's Table state at a given block_idx blocked a fresh Details from initializing at the same key because the indexer used HashMap::entry().or_insert(), a no-op when present. Fixed by overwriting stale wrong-variant entries while preserving same-section toggle state.
nodes.norm_label: toggle details no-op after section navigation (bug)

nodes.label: --filter and --level ignored in --tree mode (bug)
nodes.rationale: CLI now honors both --filter and --level flags when rendering --tree output; previously print_tree ignored --filter.

nodes.label: --at-line not wired up / -s mismatched formatted headings (bug)
nodes.rationale: --at-line now resolves to the enclosing heading; section selection (-s) now matches headings containing inline formatting, fixing main.rs::extract_section string-search against the stripped heading.text.
nodes.norm_label: --at-line not wired up / -s mismatched formatted headings (bug)

nodes.label: content_height u16 truncation (bug)
nodes.rationale: Changed content_height from u16 to usize to prevent silent overflow on documents with >65535 rendered lines; scroll clamped at ratatui's u16 boundary.

nodes.label: Terminal restoration when stdin is piped (bug)
nodes.rationale: disable_raw_mode now fully restores the original termios saved during enable_raw_mode, instead of only re-setting ICANON/ECHO/ISIG which left IEXTEN, ICRNL, OPOST etc. cleared by cfmakeraw.
nodes.norm_label: terminal restoration when stdin is piped (bug)

nodes.label: LaTeX subscript mangling code spans (bug)
nodes.rationale: Inline code containing underscores (e.g. `post_tweet`) was corrupted by the LaTeX subscript converter (_t -> ₜ). Code spans, double-backtick spans, and fenced code blocks are now protected from all LaTeX transformations via placeholder extraction/restoration.

nodes.label: Table crash at wide terminals >= 146 cols (bug)
nodes.rationale: MIN_COL_WIDTH clamping could push total column width over budget after proportional shrink; added iterative trim loop to guarantee convergence and fixed infinite loop in padding reduction.
nodes.norm_label: table crash at wide terminals >= 146 cols (bug)

nodes.label: Dynamic help text (feature)
nodes.rationale: Help popup displays actual configured keybindings instead of hardcoded key strings; structured HelpLine enum replaces raw string-based help entries.

nodes.label: Image protocol caching (perf)
nodes.rationale: Images are decoded from disk once when elements are indexed, then cached as StatefulProtocol objects, instead of re-decoding and re-creating protocols from disk every ~16ms render frame.

nodes.label: Folder navigation in file picker (feature)
nodes.rationale: Subdirectories shown at bottom of file picker with [DIR] prefix; Enter navigates into a directory, Backspace goes to parent; search filter applies to both files and directories.
